;Business and economy
*[[Trinity Mirror]] agrees to buy British publishing group [[Northern & Shell]] from [[Richard Desmond]] for £126.7 million. The deal gives Trinity Mirror ownership of the ''[[Daily Express]]'' and ''[[Daily Star (United Kingdom)|Daily Star]]'' newspapers. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2018/feb/09/trinity-mirror-buys-express-star-127m-deal-richard-desmond-ok (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Earthquakes in 2018]]
**A 5.8 [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] earthquake strikes off the coast of the [[Mexico|Mexican]] state of [[Jalisco]], prompting evacuations in the tourist resort of [[Puerto Vallarta]] and is felt in the country's second-largest metropolitan area of [[Guadalajara]]. No casualties are reported. [https://www.vallartadaily.com/news/puerto-vallarta/earthquakes-cause-evacuations-puerto-vallarta-guadalajara/ (''Puerto Vallarta Daily'')]

;Law and crime
*[[iOS jailbreaking]]
**A [[Vice (magazine)#Website|Vice Motherboard]] report traces the origin of a significant [[iOS]] source code [[Internet leak|leak]] to an Apple [[Internship|intern]] and five "friends" in the [[iOS]] [[Jailbreak (computer science)|jailbreaking]] community. [https://apple.slashdot.org/story/18/02/09/221237/apple-intern-reportedly-leaked-iphone-source-code (''The Verge'' via Slashdot)]
*[[Russian espionage in the United States]]
**The [[New York Times]] reports that the [[Central Intelligence Agency|CIA]] handed $100,000 to an unnamed [[Russian intelligence]] source in a [[Berlin]] hotel room, allegedly expecting to get back stolen [[National Security Agency|NSA]] hacking tools. [http://www.newsweek.com/cia-paid-100000-shadowy-russian-touting-trump-dirt-and-stolen-cyberweapons-802603 (''Newsweek'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Government shutdowns in the United States]]
**The [[Government of the United States|United States government]] runs out of funding for the second time this year, prompting another government shutdown. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/02/08/us/politics/congress-budget-deal-vote.html (''The New York Times'')]
**A comprehensive budget deal is later passed by [[United States Congress|Congress]] in the early hours of the morning, and a [[Continuing Resolution]] is signed into law by [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump|Trump]] that keeps the government open until March 23, 2018. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/02/08/politics/budget-vote-congress-shutdown/index.html (CNN)] [https://federalnewsradio.com/workforce/2018/03/last-months-spending-cap-deal-brings-more-certainty-to-march-23-shutdown-showdown/ (Federal News Radio)]
*[[Timeline of the Trump presidency, 2018 Q1]]
**[[Rachel Brand]], [[United States Associate Attorney General|Associate Attorney General]] since May 2017, plans to step down in the next several weeks in favor of a job in the private sector. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/02/09/rachel-brand-no-3-official-justice-department-step-down-amid-political-attacks/325042002/ (USA Today)]
*[[Politics of Turkey]]
**[[Turkey]] arrests 17 leaders of the left-wing [[Peoples' Democratic Party (Turkey)|Peoples' Democratic Party]] for [[Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War|opposition]] to the ongoing [[Turkish military operation in Afrin|Afrin offensive]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-turkey-security-kurds/turkey-orders-arrest-of-pro-kurdish-party-leader-agency-idUKKBN1FT16S (Reuters UK)]

;Science and technology
*[[Human genetics]]
**Researchers at the [[University of Edinburgh]] claim they have successfully brought prepubescent-sourced, [[Immature ovum|immature]] [[human]] [[egg cell]]s to [[Folliculogenesis|maturity]] in a laboratory for the first time. The work may be significant because it may allow the harvesting and preservation of eggs from young girls undergoing [[Chemotherapy|toxic cancer treatment]] before their lifetime reservoirs of those cells are destroyed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-42976858 (BBC)] [https://doi.org/10.1093/molehr/gay002 (''Oxford Academic'')]
*[[List of asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018|Asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018]]
**As predicted, asteroid [[2018 CB]], estimated to be between 15 and 40 metres (50–130 feet) in diameter, makes a fly-by past [[Earth]] at a distance of around 64,500 km (40,100 mi). This is the second asteroid to make a fly-by this week. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2018/feb/09/asteroid-passing-close-to-earth-today-not-need-to-worry (''The Guardian'')]

;Sport
*[[2018 Winter Olympics]]
**The 23rd [[Winter Olympic Games]] [[2018 Winter Olympics opening ceremony|start]] in [[Pyeongchang County|Pyeongchang]], [[South Korea]]. It marks the first time that South Korea has hosted the Winter Olympics. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2018/feb/09/winter-olympics-2018-day-one-curling-figure-skating-and-more-live (''The Guardian'')] [http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/cold-poor-south-korean-mountains-winter-olympics-begin-52952010 (ABC News)]
